items.reasons: The top is only a 1–2 row grey strip, so the piece reads as a flat front elevation of a tall, narrow cabinet. It is a cramped 1-tile-wide column mixing a bottle shelf and a wooden drawer base, and at 1x it is an unreadable smear that doesn't read as a drink bar next to the counter-register or the cooler.

The top plane is a pale grey band streaked with stray lighter dashes rather than a clean lit surface, and it sits right on the red header, so the depth is ambiguous. The bottle rows are noisy single-colour columns with uneven gaps compared with the orderly bottle rows in mci-cooler.

It is basically a flat front elevation: the top is only a thin 1–2 row grey rim, with no visible shelf top plane. The snack packs are saturated yellow/orange blobs with bright sticker-like highlights on a navy backing, which looks muddy and outside the chipset's restrained palette.
